input: The server returned HTTP 503. Evidence E1 is the server log that records the 503 response.
We do not know whether the database is unavailable.
Overload has been proposed as a possible cause of the failure.
The request timed out. Evidence LOG17 records the timeout. The root cause is unknown. Network failure has been proposed as a possible explanation.
Service A returned HTTP 500 according to evidence E2. Service B returned HTTP 404 according to evidence E3.
Evidence TRACE9 records both a connection reset and a request retry.
Evidence E4 records high CPU usage. High CPU usage is observed. Memory pressure is only a proposed explanation for the incident.
Evidence E7 records a failed health check. Evidence E8 records a successful DNS lookup. The failed health check is established by E7. We do not know whether DNS caused the incident.
Packet loss is a hypothesis. Whether packet loss is the root cause remains unknown.

Evidence LOG21 records authentication failure. Authentication failure occurred. Evidence TRACE22 records a retry. A retry occurred. We do not know whether credentials were expired. Clock skew has been proposed as a possible cause.
